<a id="demo_input_data"></a>
### [`demo_input_data`](../../../src/demo_input.asm#L6) `$F300-$F538`

*data*

Demo-mode input: update_actors ($179E) reads one byte per main-loop pass through demo_input_ptr ($1D, set to $F300 at $0570 and $074F); low nibble -> actor_joy_dir (Bruce), high nibble -> actor_joy_fire (0 = fire). No end marker.

- **Referred to by:** [`start_demo`](restart.md#start_demo) [`$0570`](../../../src/restart.asm#L50), [`start_demo`](restart.md#start_demo) [`$0574`](../../../src/restart.asm#L52), [`title_screen`](title.md#title_screen) [`$074F`](../../../src/title.asm#L211), [`title_screen`](title.md#title_screen) [`$0753`](../../../src/title.asm#L213), [`$CFD0`](../../../src/protection_signature.asm#L62) (+255)
